items.title: Case Study: Custom E-Commerce Platform
items.challenge: A fashion brand needed a scalable e-commerce platform with centralized inventory management and a unique checkout experience.
items.solution: We built a progressive web app (PWA) using Next.js for the frontend and a headless backend system for maximum flexibility.
items.outcome: Increased sales conversion by 25% and page load time 40% faster compared to the previous platform.

items.title: Case Study: Team Productivity Mobile App
items.challenge: A creative agency struggled to track project progress and team workflow while working remotely.
items.solution: We developed a native mobile app for iOS and Android allowing task management, time tracking, and real-time team communication.
items.outcome: Increased team efficiency by 35% and reduced weekly coordination meeting time by 50%.
